select a.id, a.name, a.customer_id, b.name as customer, (select group_concat(distinct s.name order by s.name separator '、') from crm_business_product p2 inner join crm_supplier s on p2.supplier_id = s.id where p2.bus_id = a.id) as supplier, a.owner_user, a.bus_status, a.deal_time, a.contact_status, a.contact_amount, a.credit_amount, a.remark, a.fail_remark, a.creator as creator_id, e.user_name as creator, a.updater as updater_id, c.user_name as updater, a.create_time, a.update_time, a.deleted, (select count(1) from crm_business_product p where p.bus_id = a.id) as product_count, (select c2.id from crm_contract c2 where c2.bus_id = a.id and c2.deleted = 0 order by c2.id desc limit 1) as contract_id, (select c3.contact_no from crm_contract c3 where c3.bus_id = a.id and c3.deleted = 0 order by c3.id desc limit 1) as contract_no, case when exists (select 1 from crm_contract c4 where c4.bus_id = a.id and c4.deleted = 0) then 1 else 0 end as has_contract from crm_business a left join crm_customer b on a.customer_id = b.id left join sys_user c on a.updater = c.user_id left join sys_user e on a.creator = e.user_id
